checks.name: Partition Isolation (Development Only)
checks.details: Evaluated exactly 107 development tiles. Holdout partition (107 tiles) remained strictly unopened and unaccessed.

checks.name: No Reference Error Leakage
checks.details: Pixel replacement masks were formed strictly by ranking uncertainty maps (or Sobel / random seeds). NAIP reference was used solely for final evaluation.

checks.name: Deterministic Masking & Tie Breaking
checks.details: Replacement masks use exact pixel counts (1440, 2880, 4320 pixels for 10%, 20%, 30%). Lexicographical sorting ensures deterministic tie handling.

checks.name: Random Mask Control Multi-Seed Distribution
checks.details: Random replacement was evaluated across 5 recorded seeds per tile. Both mean and dispersion across seeds were recorded.

checks.name: Primary Scientific Comparison (Hybrid vs Random)
checks.details: At 20% budget: Hybrid MAE (0.07989) vs Random MAE (0.08212), paired delta = -0.00222, p = 9.86e-22.

checks.name: Gradient Magnitude & Sharpness Accounting
checks.details: Evaluated gradient magnitude and gradient MAE vs reference across all arms to monitor resolution preservation.
